revision_note: The harbor drivers, adapters and scorer comparators are developed across two private lines that have diverged: the Science-Vision monorepo carries them under scripts/harbor/, harbor_adapters/ and sci3d_bench/scorers/, while the eval-baseline line of BabyVision-v2 carries the continuous September-October work and the isolated scorer_bundle. The commit above pins the line the reported results were produced on, and at that revision the source declares Apache-2.0. Consolidating the two lines and relicensing the result under this repository's MIT license are preconditions for publishing the harness.
validation_note: The upstream pull request reports scorer self-consistency checks. They are not model benchmark results and were not rerun for this repository.
